# Evidence grades: prevention, slowing and reversal

Grades: **A** replicated/adequately powered RCTs on a clinical endpoint; **A-null** adequately powered RCT(s) with no benefit; **B** single RCT, subgroup, biomarker-only or strong natural experiment; **C** small, open-label, observational or mechanistic; **D** uncontrolled, animal-only or regulator-rejected; **pending** decisive trial not yet read out.

No intervention has been shown to reverse Alzheimer's disease. Figures were taken from the landscape review and are not yet re-derived by this project (`verified` column).

This is a research summary, not medical advice.
